{{Quote|The Foundry's specifications match those of three other space stations known by history. Each of these legendary stations could manufacture technology on a massive scale. One xenoformed planets; another built fleets of ships.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="TOR:CtA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Call to Arms|the ''White Nova''}}</ref>}}
During the rule of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species built at least three gigantic [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], including the [[Star Forge]], the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], and a '''station''' that could [[Terraforming/Legends|xenoform]] entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Estimated to have been built sometime between [[35,000 BBY]] and the fall of the Infinite Empire around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], the station was discovered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]].
